wsl-claude close: 1) pull the vault; 2) file your quotes from the session as notes in input/wsl-claude; 3) compile them into my procedures and ledger, push; 4) pull SpiritOS, run the harness (no board post), report counts. Nothing in it touches Desk.

how hard would it be to report and track via the desk app?

Not hard: most of it exists. Three pieces, rough guess. (1) The close report as its own entry in Desk, not a Team note: small, about an hour (Desk already knows a 'report' kind). (2) Test results tracked per item: each test names its item id, and every test run on either machine posts red or green, with the time and the machine, straight to Desk, which shows them under the item. Medium, a sitting for wsl (runner) and me (Desk). It replaces the old board post. (3) Items, decisions and Done already live in Desk. Missing: nothing. Order I'd take: (2), then (1).

wsl-claude: reporting is easy, no code: each close gets its own item id (e.g. close/2026-09-28), and each agent posts its steps and results under it. Tracking the steps as ticks in Desk is a small Desk change, claude-windows' to size.
